expertsFailed: The directory could not be searched.

updatesHelp: FBR SROs, circulars, and notifications. Replay uses the saved listing, so a slow FBR page cannot wipe what is already stored.
updatesFailed: The updates feed could not be loaded.
privacyAccounts: There is no account. A session id on this device keeps the chat and checklist progress.
privacyPii: CNIC, NTN, phone, email, and bank numbers are masked in the browser and again on the server before any model call. Uploaded notices are not stored.
privacySources: A verified answer cites the ordinance text in the library. A web answer cites the official page it was taken from and is not marked verified.
privacyExperts: Expert listings are public firm pages. They are not an endorsement. Each card shows the source, the date, and how to ask for removal.
privacyWeb: Official pages come from FBR, IRIS, SECP, and the provincial revenue authorities on the allowlist. A crawl that fetches nothing leaves the previous pages in place.
shareFailed: The answer could not be copied.
evalAblationMissing: The ablation report has not been written yet.
